subject: ours:harness-evaluate
why: Critic round 1, findings 1 and 2: the adoption order now takes the curation playbook branch for its kind. A trait adopt goes owner ruling, pending adopt, build and behaviour checks, then the completing adopt superseding the pending one, before the final registry build and check (which fails while the target lists the trait without it). A whole-capability adopt or adopt-merged goes owner ruling, build and behaviour checks, then one event once the adopted state exists, with no pending form. The adopt-after-state-exists definition is reworded to the delivering event, same meaning. Traits unchanged; tree hash refreshed in traits/ours.yaml.
